sloka: भर्तारम् न अनुवर्तेत सा च पाप गतिर् भवेत् ।भर्तुः शुश्रूषया नारी लभते स्वर्गमु त्तमम् ॥२-२४-२५॥
transliteration: bhartāram na anuvarteta sā ca pāpa gatir bhavet ।bhartuḥ śuśrūṣayā nārī labhate svargamu ttamam ॥2-24-25॥

translations.english: A woman may be highly pious engaged in vows and fastings, but if she does not follow her husband, she will be condemned to hell.
